title: Job Openings at Kiddies Oasis School
content:
Kiddies Oasis School is a private educational institution located in Lagos, Nigeria. It provides a comprehensive early childhood and primary education framework, offering services across creche, preschool, and primary school categories.

We are recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:

1.) IRS Teacher

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time

Requirements
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Graduate qualification
	At least 3 years of teaching experience in a Nursery/Primary school
	Good communication skills
	Self-driven and dedicated
	Applicants must reside within the Baruwa–Ipaja axis of Lagos State.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications and relevant documents in PDF format in PDF to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

 

 

2.) English Language Teacher

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time

Requirements

	Good communication skills
	Self-driven and dedicated
	Applicants must reside within the Baruwa–Ipaja axis of Lagos State.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications and relevant documents in PDF format in PDF to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

3.) Mathematics Teacher

Job Location: Lagos

Operations Support Officer Job at Crimson Oak Partners




        
    

        
        Crimson Oak Partners is an advisory and professional services firm based in Lagos, Nigeria, committed to assisting future growth and sustainability for emerging corporations and businesses. The firm focuses on the delivery of bespoke financial solutions, business strategy, market insights, and advisory services, with the aim of empowering African businesses to excel in a competitive business environment.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Operations Support Officer

Job Location: Abuja (Hybrid)

About the Role
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an Operations Support team member to provide day-to-day administrative and operational support across the organisation.
	The role will involve coordinating internal processes, supporting team activities, maintaining accurate records, assisting with logistics, and ensuring smooth execution of routine operational tasks.
	The ideal candidate is organised, proactive, reliable, detail-oriented, and willing to learn and take ownership of tasks.


Key Responsibilities


	Support the smooth day-to-day running of office operations and administrative activities
	Coordinate logistics for meetings, events, staff activities, and other company engagements
	Assist with procurement, office supplies, vendor coordination, and facilities-related activities


Requirements


	NYSC Corps Member or recent graduate with a Bachelor's Degree in any relevant field
	Strong organisational and time-management skills
	Good attention to detail and ability to multitask
	Good written and verbal communication skills
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office/Google Workspace
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team
	Proactive, reliable, and willing to learn
	Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills
	Maintain accurate records of expenses, invoices, documents, and operational activities
	Support the preparation of reports, memos, presentations, and other internal documents
	Follow up on assigned tasks and action points to ensure timely completion.


Benefits
Opportunity for professional growth and hands-on experience.
